hypothesis: Website studios may pay for immediate awareness of visits on their own sites.

newContacts.name: Anchor Web Digital
newContacts.opening: Your Grow care plan includes monthly reports. I wondered whether seeing visits arrive between those reports would be useful on your own agency site.

newContacts.name: Arise Technology
newContacts.opening: Your Care plan is aimed at businesses that update and promote their sites. I am testing whether immediate visitor awareness is useful alongside that ongoing work.

newContacts.name: Week One Sites
newContacts.opening: Your seven-day website launch service caught my attention. The moment after a launch is exactly when I want to notice the first arrivals.

newContacts.name: BananaSystems
newContacts.opening: You offer managed websites and custom tools for Southampton businesses. I would value your assessment of a small visitor-alert tool on your own site.

newContacts.name: Copper Lane
newContacts.opening: Your services include local SEO and missed-call text-back for owners away from their desks. I am exploring a related question: would they also value noticing website visits on their phone?

newContacts.name: Matthew Temple Consulting
newContacts.opening: Your website care plans cover hosting, updates, backups, and security. I would like to test a separate visitor-awareness tool on a studio site like yours.

newContacts.name: SmartersWeb
newContacts.opening: You offer WordPress help and website care for small businesses and lean teams. I am looking for a website owner comfortable adding a small tracking script to evaluate a visitor-alert tool.

newContacts.name: WebQuick
newContacts.opening: Your care plans support sites whether WebQuick built them or not. I would value your view of the installation experience for a small visitor-alert tool on your own site.

offer: Existing 14-day Starter trial, no card required, USD19/month if continued; installation help by email.
success: Independent owner installs on their own site, receives a visit, and subsequently pays; all must be verified.
stopRule: Review substantive replies and independent installs after five business days before expanding this audience. No automatic follow-ups without checking replies and opt-outs.
